notes.title: The not-so-spooky Halloween Update!
notes.content:
As we said on previous updates we are happy to announce a big update for Smithy Wars!

On this new update you'll be able to solve puzzles to unlock chests, evade traps, build walls and outposts for your base!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Ygkc0hyXo4XVtd4nUV/giphy.gif[/img]

Loot is procedurally generated! So players that don't know how to enchant will be able to get pre-enchanted loot. Its not as optimized as a custom made item as some players min-maxed ([url=https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1700657868635206088/3B29782606FA7BA82FEA30EA3664C8147EFD517D/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false]Eyeing that pendant![/url]) 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Px2KJ9vIyI9S7qsW2o/giphy.gif[/img]

Mark the date and play Smithy Wars on Halloween, free update for all players that already bought the game!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/5Ck8wiplfolCwjh4VM/giphy.gif[/img]

notes.title: [News] Upcoming Modes: Adventure Mode & Conquer Mode
notes.content:
Hey guys!

So the new update was a bit delayed since I wanted to post it mid-September, but when I finished making the adventure mode I found that just clicking a button and automatically starting the adventure was a bit lacking.

So I decided to add a map of sorts. But, since you got your own base, just adding the map seemed empty. In short, a new mode will accompany the adventure mode, which is the Conquer Mode. Each of you will be able to explore your surroundings and even claim them to further expand the territory of your base.

The idea is to add a sense of discovery, wariness of your neighbors and a nice extension of PVP where there's something else at risk. You may invade other people's base and build walls on the map.

Most of the content is already coded and done for. I'm just missing some details and adding polish. We're going to add a discount when the update hits so expect a flow of people when this starts. As always feedback is always appreciated. And now... the screenshots!!

[h1]Adventure Mode[/h1]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40894336/cba0b9d566bb8c96fcf9bd33fb90d717e4430ad5.png[/img]
Several places to go on an adventure

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40894336/07f5fc323b6aa6422e33383bad2c473ccf6bf769.png[/img]
Solve puzzles!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40894336/4d109651f09a2b71f52f8afeaf0cc36ba18320f0.png[/img]
Gain Loot! Avoid traps!


[h1]Conquer Mode[/h1]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40894336/da7c5ad1b6fa0f01496de838a59a762baa8d1a2c.png[/img]
Preview of the conquer mode. Expand your territory, meet other players on the map, fight them and steal all gems they acquired on their adventures!


[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40894336/9d2af765b117413f97900bfc845a9292890742d5.png[/img]
Build walls and outposts. Walls block all movement (yours and enemies), outposts force enemies to fight your team to proceed! 


And that's it for now! Keep tuned for more!

notes.title: New features in Smithy Wars and best players so far!
notes.content:
Hi guys! Its been a wild week! 

We're going to give a bit of a recap of where is Smithy Wars going and mention a new feature to help the early levels.

For starters we got a bumpy start, seems Smithy is a bit harder than I anticipated and we had some people quit way prematurely. On the other side, the ones who stayed seemed to have really stuck! Thus we're going to reward the ones who stayed and help those who quit with a new feature

[h1]Adventure Mode[/h1]

We're going to add a new mode that allows players to explore a bit more and get magical rewards for people that need a bit of help with enchanting. Players will be able to explore a random adventure and get gems, equipment with basic enchantments and fight bosses!

Finally I leave you with a small sneak peek:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40894336/12bd30bbf3ad9d9f346afb09ff00d98c9f2ce6bb.png[/img]


[h1]And now the champions![/h1]
We're a small community so I'd feel bad if I don't put a small leaderboard of our best players so far!
